summary: VersaBank filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Notice of Special Meeting, proxy, management information circular, and letter of transmittal for a September 16, 2026 shareholder vote on a reorganization. Under the plan, Versa Bancorp, a Delaware holding company, will become the public parent of VersaBank, a Canadian Schedule I bank, succeeding it as the publicly traded entity. The board unanimously recommends voting FOR the reorganization. The circular includes a special resolution in Annex A; no financial terms or per-share consideration are disclosed in the excerpt. The transaction resembles a US holding-company reorganization or exchange offer; watch for shareholder approval and regulatory clearances in Canada and the US.
